text: Long catch-up with Emeka over lunch. He's moved to Leeds now and works for the council in planning. His sister Ines is still in Lagos, teaching. He and his wife celebrate ten years on 2 November 2026 so I should send something nice that week.
Zoe's little one starts reception on September 3rd. She's more nervous than he is, honestly. Text her that morning.
Mohammed and Sara got engaged!! Proposed on the beach in Cornwall last weekend. Wedding probably summer 2027, they're thinking August. Need to send a card.
Isaac lives in Bristol, rents a flat near the harbour. Works as a sound engineer. Two kids, both at primary. Wife's called Tamar, she's a midwife.

Ran into Ayo at the school gates. Her eldest, Chris, has his GCSE results on August 20th and she says he's been a wreck about it. Her husband's away for work most of that month too. Don't forget to message Chris good luck the night before, and check how Ayo's coping.
Stefan Schmidt - grew up in Hamburg, now in Glasgow with his partner Leon. Works in renewables. Allergic to shellfish.
Naledi graduates from Edinburgh on June 28th, 2027! Masters in public health. Her mum's flying over from Joburg for it.
Yetunde and Owen's anniversary is 5/14. Fifteen years. They're doing a little dinner, I'm invited.
Called Ellie. The wedding's been called off, she and Joe split up in September. She's staying with her parents in Reading for now. Ring her again next week, she sounded flat.
Kate mentioned Mehmet's driving test is October 30th. Third attempt. He's trying to play it cool but she says he's barely sleeping.
Pick up dry cleaning, renew passport before March 2027, book the boiler service.
Lindiwe works at the hospital in Cape Town, paediatrics. Her brother Amir moved to Toronto last year. Their mum lives with Lindiwe now. She loves gardening and reads constantly, crime mostly.
Svetlana's daughter graduated nursery today lol, there was a tiny cap and everything. Photos on the family chat.
Agnieszka and her husband renew their vows on 12 July 2027 in Krakow. She asked if I'd come. I'm going, already told her yes.
Aoife's son Reggie is doing his eleven plus in mid September. She's anxious, he's oblivious. Remind me to ask Aoife how it went once results are out, they come in October.
Gemma - lives in Margate, freelance illustrator, cat called Biscuit. Vegan. Dad's a retired vicar.
Rana's first day at the new school is January 6th. She's starting Year 9 halfway through, which is rough. Her mum Elena said she's been crying about it. Must check in with Elena the week after.
Aleksander proposed to Sinead on her birthday, March 4th. Ring was his grandmother's. They want a winter wedding, maybe December 2027.
Ilse Bianchi, Ilse from book club. Married to Owen. They live in Bath. She's an architect and he teaches maths at the grammar.
Emeka's twins sit their A levels next May. Nothing to do yet, just noting it.

Ines said her parents' 40th anniversary is June 3rd. The whole family's doing a big lunch at the house. Ines hinted they'd love a framed photo of the wedding day, the original got water damaged in the move. Should sort that before end of May.

Caught up with Mohammed for the first time in ages. Still at the bank, now head of compliance. His wife Zoe is on maternity leave, baby due 18 November 2026. They've bought a house in Harrogate and move in December. His mum is coming to stay for a month once the baby arrives. He seemed tired but happy. I should send a hamper after the birth.
Note to self: Isaac's daughter's university graduation was yesterday. Forgot to message. Send congrats today!
Chris and Naledi are getting married October 9th, 2027. Venue's a barn outside Oxford. Save the date came in the post.
Sara's moving to Lisbon in February for work. Her boyfriend Stefan is staying in London for now, which she's not thrilled about.
Tamar Lee: two sons, Joe (14) and Leon (9). Ex-husband in Manchester. She's in Didsbury, works in HR at a uni.
Yetunde's niece passed her driving test on the first go. Proud auntie energy all evening.
Owen's father is having his hip done on 11/18. Owen's taking time off to look after him. Text Owen that day to see how it went.
Wedding anniversary dinner booked for us, Saturday 7th at 8pm. Flowers to collect Friday.
Kate's eldest finishes uni this summer and graduates July 15th. She's trying to find a grad scheme in London, nothing yet. Kate's worried. Her younger one Aoife just started sixth form.
Mehmet Singh, Mo to everyone. Lives in Leicester with his wife and their three girls. Runs a print shop. Massive cricket fan.

Lindiwe and Agnieszka are both doing the Year 6 SATs prep thing with their kids. Lindiwe's boy is fine, Agnieszka's daughter is really struggling with maths and getting upset. Exams are May 2027. I said I'd lend them the practice books, need to drop them round this weekend.
Gemma and Reggie celebrated their first anniversary on April 22nd. Paper anniversary, he made her a pop-up card apparently.
Svetlana's in Riga until the end of the month, visiting her grandmother. Back on the 31st.

Coffee with Amir. He's teaching at a primary in Hackney, Year 2. Lives with his girlfriend Rana in Walthamstow. She's a pharmacist. They've got a rescue greyhound called Pepper. Amir's into bouldering and has started doing it three times a week. Rana's brother is a chef at a place in Soho.
Elena and Aleksander's engagement party, Saturday 14 March 2027, at her parents' place. Need a gift, they're registered at John Lewis.
Sinead texted: her son's first day at nursery was today and he didn't cry, she did. Call her tomorrow evening.
Leon got into Durham to do law!! Starts October 2026. His dad Stefan is beside himself.
Ilse's mum turns 70 on December 2nd. Ilse wants to do a surprise party but her sister thinks it's too much. Undecided.
Need to RSVP to Emeka's daughter's christening by Friday. It's November 15th at St Mary's.
Ines and Ayo have been married eight years as of last Sunday. Didn't realise until she posted. Message her congrats belatedly.
Zoe works in Manchester, digital marketing. Grew up in Sheffield. Her dad's Greek, mum's from Doncaster. Hates coriander.
Isaac's exam was rescheduled to 3/12/2027, the accountancy one. He'd been dreading the original date anyway. Wish him luck the day before.

Talked to Sara on the phone for an hour. Her sister Naledi's wedding is on August 8th in Durban and Sara's maid of honour. She's stressing about the speech. Their grandad isn't well enough to fly so they'll video call him in. I should help Sara with the speech next week, and ask how the grandad's doing.
Chris starts his teacher training in January 2027. Packed in the office job last month.
Tamar's little girl lost her first tooth. That's it, that's the update, very cute.
Remind me: Yetunde's son graduates from Leeds Beckett on July 19th. Card + money.
Joe's leaving do got cancelled because half the team had covid. They'll reschedule for sometime in November.
Mrs Hughes next door told me her grandson Owen just got engaged to a girl from Cardiff. She's knitting them a blanket already.
Ellie is doing a part-time PGCE alongside her job. Lives in Brighton. Still with Mehmet, five years now. They've got a cockapoo called Rolo. She's thinking about moving closer to her mum.
Kate and Agnieszka are both in my running group. Kate's half marathon is October 25th, Agnieszka's doing the 10k same day. I'm doing the 10k too.
Gemma's brother Amir is getting married next spring, April 2027, in Istanbul. She's already booked flights. Her parents aren't speaking to the bride's family, long story.
Reggie's daughter got her A level results back - straight As, off to Bristol for medicine. Should send her something, maybe a voucher.
Lindiwe's father passed away on Thursday. Funeral's on the 29th in Durban, she's flying out on the 25th. Check in with her before she leaves and again when she's back.

Dinner at Svetlana's. Her husband Aleksander does something in cybersecurity. Their son starts secondary next September, they've applied to three schools, find out in March 2027. Svetlana makes the best pelmeni.
Elena's twins' 5th birthday is November 2nd. They're obsessed with dinosaurs, anything T-rex. Sinead and I are going halves on a present.

Weekend recap - Sunday lunch with Ilse, Emeka and Mohammed. Ilse's starting a new job at the BBC on November 10th, she's nervous about the commute more than anything. Emeka and Ines are going to Ghana for Christmas, December 18th to January 5th. Mohammed's finally finished his PhD, viva passed last Tuesday, graduation in July 2027. Remind me to send Mohammed a congrats card and to text Ilse on her first day.
Ayo told me Isaac and Tamar's 25th wedding anniversary is 6/21. Their kids are planning something secret. Ask Ayo what we can chip in for.
Nothing much from the call with Zoe, just general chat about the weather and the new bus timetable.
Stefan's mum had her cataract op this morning, went well. He's staying with her through Wednesday. Ask him Thursday how she's healing.
